notes: Run sequentially (EmilyKin 18:44-19:05, codiffusion 19:05-19:15 on 2026-11-12), each as its own systemd-run --user unit (MemoryMax=40G, MemorySwapMax=0), --procs 8, fetching on.

Wall time is far above the 354 s measured earlier for EmilyKin: the 64-core host was shared with other sessions' jobs (load average 35-56 during the runs; ~10 other single-core python jobs at 100% CPU). CPU time (user) is in time_v.

memory.cgroup_memory_peak reaches the 40 GiB MemoryMax through page cache (genome files streamed and written), as documented in reweight_build_e3.py; process memory is max_cgroup_anon (sum over the parent and 8 fork workers, shared copy-on-write pages counted once) and max_sum_pss.

feature_probability_before_after is pooled over features (not a mean of per-genome means) of the applied (n >= 2) genomes only; 'replaced' = features with a PGFam (provenance probability_kn keys); features without one keep k/n.

write_mapping_provenance.py was re-run on each new directory with the inputs and text options of the shipped 2026-11-04 call (recovered from the shipped mapping_provenance.json), the dataset name suffixed ', E3 feature probabilities' and --build-command naming the reweight step; its build method text describes E3 from the manifest _meta.pfunc. abstained_asvs.csv and asv_mapping_summary.csv are byte-identical to the shipped ones.
Each new directory also holds reweight_build_e3.log (the run's stdout/stderr).
Nothing was uploaded to KBase; kbase_upload_log.json is not copied (it records the uploads of the k/n objects).
